selection.reason: To remove WEBGL, we need to update setup() (removing the WEBGL flag) and the drawing functions (draw and drawEntities) to use standard 2D primitives and coordinate systems. To make the ball bigger, we will likely need to adjust its size in resetBall() or prelude.
